seo.title: ODDference — what business can learn from creative expertise
seo.description: ODD's flagship professional event, built around one question: what can business and the rest of society learn from creative expertise?

title: What can business learn from creative expertise?
intro: ODDference is ODD's flagship, centrally produced event — built entirely around one question: what can business and the rest of society learn from creative expertise? Creative professionals aren't the entertainment here; their ways of working are the actual content.

features.title: Talks & panels
features.body: Founders, creative leaders and policymakers on the same stage, addressing the same questions — not separate tracks that never meet.

features.title: Matchmaking
features.body: Structured time built into the day to meet people you wouldn't otherwise cross paths with.

features.title: Straight into ODDfest
features.body: ODDference runs straight into the wider ODDfest programme — the conversation continues past the closing session.

bigQuestion.headline: What can business and the rest of society learn from creative expertise?
bigQuestion.body: Creative professionals work daily with uncertainty, cultural relevance, storytelling, community and ambiguity — the same problems most organisations are quietly struggling with. ODDference treats that expertise as the main event, not the warm-up act to a business conference.

whoItsFor.label: Business leaders
whoItsFor.description: Facing decisions that don't have a playbook yet — creative process has more to offer here than another case study.

whoItsFor.label: Organisational leaders
whoItsFor.description: Managing culture and change that need more than an org chart to actually move.

whoItsFor.label: Entrepreneurs
whoItsFor.description: Building something new, with the same uncertainty a creative practice deals with every day.

whoItsFor.label: Policymakers
whoItsFor.description: Shaping the conditions creative and cultural work actually happens in — worth hearing directly from the people working inside them.

whoItsFor.label: Creative leaders
whoItsFor.description: Looking for a room where creative expertise is treated as the expertise it is, not decoration.

whyAttend.title: New perspectives
whyAttend.body: Leave with a genuinely different way of thinking about a problem you brought in, not just a stack of slides.

whyAttend.title: Relevant connections
whyAttend.body: Meet people solving adjacent problems from a completely different discipline.

whyAttend.title: Practical ideas
whyAttend.body: Talks and sessions built to translate into something you can actually use, not just admire.

themes.title: Creative leadership
themes.body: What organisational leadership can learn from how creative teams actually make decisions under uncertainty.

themes.title: Culture & attention
themes.body: How cultural relevance, storytelling and audience attention actually work — and what that means for brands, cities and institutions.

themes.title: Creative economy & technology
themes.body: Where creative practice, new technology and economic models are colliding right now, and what's worth paying attention to.

connection.headline: Built for meaningful encounters, not passive stage time.
connection.body: Talks and panels are half of ODDference. The rest is built-in time and structure — matchmaking, facilitated conversations, shared meals — designed to turn a room of strangers into working relationships.

faq.question: When and where is the next ODDference?
faq.answer: Dates and venue for the next edition are still being finalised — join the mailing list and we'll let you know as soon as they're confirmed.

faq.question: Is the venue accessible?
faq.answer: Accessibility details will be published alongside the venue once it's confirmed.

faq.question: How do tickets work?
faq.answer: Ticket types and pricing aren't set yet — check back here or get in touch and we'll keep you posted.

faq.question: Is there time built in to actually meet people?
faq.answer: Yes — structured networking and matchmaking time is built into the day alongside the stage programme, not left to chance.
